_comment: Provenance record (§B.7). The signing infrastructure shipped (ML3.2 / DE-04); the first-party pack is distributed UNSIGNED and trusted by default under DE-04 Option C. See the signing block below.

corpus.note: 100% synthetic; no real PII at any stage. MLF-4 expanded the corpus 291->2958 with value/format/locale + header-style diversity; generation is now a pure function of the column index, so every high-cardinality column's value set is disjoint from all same-label columns (§A.3 leakage guard provable, not probabilistic). build_cryptic_fixtures() adds a 210-column held-out cryptic-header benchmark for the CH-3 ablation. OOD slice includes spaced-PAN and no-dash SSN obfuscation (§B.2).

privacy.deployment_constraint: on-prem only (§B.5); SHA-256 verified before joblib.load

signing.policy: The shipped first-party pack is distributed UNSIGNED and trusted by default (DE-04 Option C): it is sha256-verified and force-included in the wheel, so classify_fields() loads it out of the box. HMAC-SHA256 signing (decoy_engine.storm.model_pack.provenance.sign_pack) is OPT-IN: a signature is enforced for a caller-supplied external pack_dir (untrusted by default), and for the trusted default pack whenever DECOY_PACK_REQUIRE_SIGNATURE=1 OR DECOY_PACK_SIGNING_KEY is set. Note: setting the key alone makes the shipped unsigned default pack refuse to load, and classify_fields() then degrades to the regex baseline via load_with_fallback(). This is a deliberate posture, not pending work.
signing.verification_command: DECOY_PACK_SIGNING_KEY=<64-hex> python -c "from pathlib import Path; from decoy_engine.storm.model_pack.loader import ModelPackLoader; ModelPackLoader(Path('<external_pack_dir>'), trusted=False).load()"
